description: A password put through a hash that takes no salt, in both of Node's spellings: chained onto createHash, and stored in a variable first. Following the assignment back is what keeps those one rule rather than two shapes. The negatives are the discriminator itself -- a password COMPOSED with something else before hashing has a salt, whatever that salt is worth, and a digest of ordinary request data is how caches are keyed.

expected.note: chained straight onto createHash; medium because the method chain resolves as probable rather than to an imported symbol
the same weakness written across two statements, found by following the assignment back to the createHash that made the receiver
